Mat Ryan dropped from Australia squad for Brazil friendlies

Goalkeeper Mat Ryan, the former captain of the Australian national football team (Socceroos), has been excluded from the squad for upcoming friendly matches against Brazil. The team is scheduled to play Brazil in two friendlies. Ryan's absence marks a significant change for the team's lineup.
